name: Geometric CFG Guider
plain: Mixes two positive predictions by a weighted geometric mean, not a linear one, then applies CFG against the negative. Negative values make complex powers and only the real part is kept.
math:
r = Re(c₁^{1−α}·c₂^{α}) in complex arithmetic, c₁=cond1, c₂=cond2
x̂ = cfg_function(r, u, s)
label: from code

audit.note: Exponents are swapped as written. endman100 nodes.py:530-534 and 559: out[2] is cond1 (positive), out[1] is cond2 (positive2), res = cond1^(1−α)·cond2^α. Math only holds if c₁ means out[1], which is cond2, and the entry never says so. Alpha is the weight of cond2.
